title: jasminum humile f. farreri
intro: Jasminum humile f. farreri, commonly known as the Rock Jasmine or Trailing Jasmine, is a flowering plant that belongs to the family Oleaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing anxiety and stress, promoting relaxation, and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to modulate the nervous system and promote a sense of calmness. Bioactive constituents present in Jasminum humile f. farreri include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
